name: vllm_copy_blocks
description: Faithfully extracted from KernelGenBench vLLM test_copy_blocks.py. Copies KV cache blocks per a block_mapping. gen_inputs builds single-element lists key_caches/value_caches=[randn(num_blocks,num_heads,head_size,block_size)] fp16 and a non-overlapping block_mapping=stack(perm[:m], perm[m:2m]) int64 (matches the test's randperm scheme to avoid src/dst races). run() mutates the lists in place and returns (key_caches, value_caches). config=(num_blocks, num_heads, head_size, block_size, num_mappings). Exact PyTree comparison. Requires vLLM at eval time.
